Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_drive_date date ;
 X BOOLEAN ;
 al_id alert;
 al_button number; 
begin
 nullchk_trg;
 --First Check if an exact drive has been entered, Past or Future does not matter
 --But if a drive has not been entered it has to pick up from the future

 IF length(:control_block.drive_id ) > 2 THEN
 /*-- Check for access --*/
 Begin
 select drives.drive_id, drives.drive_date
 into :control_block.drive_id,v_drive_date
 from drive_sponsors, sponsors, drives
 where drives.drive_type in ('I','C') 
 and drives.program_id != 'MCIFIXDR' 
 and drives.status in ('CNFRM','HOLD')
 and ((drives.drive_id like '%'||:control_block.drive_id ||'%'
 and drive_date > sysdate + :day_limit )
 or (drives.drive_id = :control_block.drive_id))
 and sponsors.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drives.drive_id = drive_sponsors.drive_id
 and drive_sponsors.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_sponsors.sponsor_id = sponsors.sponsor_id
 and (exists (select 'x'
 from system_users
 where system_users.staff_no = drives.recruiter_id
 and system_users.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and system_users.user_id =LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 or exists (select 'x'
 from valid_user_privs vup
 where vup.prim_user_id = 
 ( select staff_no
 from system_users
 where staff_no = vup.prim_user_id
 and user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and vup.sec_user_id = drives.recruiter_id
 and vup.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between vup.eff_date and nvl(vup.term_date,sysdate+1))
 or exists (select 'x' 
 from VALID_USER_ACCESS_CLASSES
 where access_class ='DRIVE' 
 and user_id =LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)));
 
 Exception
 WHEN others THEN
 X := show_lov('DRIVES_LOV');
 if not X then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 End ;
 ELSE
 show_error('11330') ;
 End if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
declare
 new_id varchar2(10) ;
 v_staff_type varchar2(5) ;
 v_hourly_rate number ;
 v_open_time date ;
 v_close_time date ;
 cursor c1 is
 select staff_no 
 from fixed_site_staff
 where site_id = :drives.location_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and :drives.drive_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:drives.drive_date+1) ;
begin
 if :control_block.drive_id = 'NEW' then
 create_ids('DRV',new_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 :drives.drive_id := new_id ;
 :control_block.drive_id := new_id ;
 end if ;
 :drives.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id ;
 :drives.program_id := :banner.prog_name ;
 :drives.status := 'CNFRM' ;
 ---:drives.drive_type := 'F' ;
 :drives.drive_category := :drives.s_drive_category ;

 /*-- Populate DRIVE_EMPLOYEES table --*/
 begin
 select open_time, close_time 
 into v_open_time, v_close_time
 from locations
 where location_id = :drives.location_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 if v_open_time is not null and v_close_time is not null then
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 v_staff_type := null ;
 v_hourly_rate := 0 ;
 begin
 select staff_type, nvl(hourly_rate,0)
 into v_staff_type, v_hourly_rate
 from employees
 where staff_no = c1rec.staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then goto iter ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ; 
 if v_staff_type is null then
 goto iter ;
 end if ; 
 begin
 insert into drive_employees
 (drive_id,
 chapter_id,
 staff_no,
 in_time,
 out_time,
 staff_type,
 hourly_rate,
 program_id)
 values
 (:drives.drive_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 c1rec.staff_no,
 to_date(to_char(:drives.drive_date,'MMDDRR')||' '||to_char(v_open_time,'HH24:MI'),'MMDDRR HH24:MI'),
 to_date(to_char(:drives.drive_date,'MMDDRR')||' '||to_char(v_close_time,'HH24:MI'),'MMDDRR HH24:MI'),
 v_staff_type,
 v_hourly_rate,
 :banner.prog_name) ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 <<iter>>
 null ; 
 end loop ;
 end if ;
end ;

--

--
DECLARE

 --

 --

 --
 -- End DRIVE_SPONSORS detail declare section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail declare section

 WHERE NOTE_ID = :DRIVES.NOTE_ID;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_SPONSORS detail program section
 --
 OPEN DRIVE_SPONSORS_cur; 
 FETCH DRIVE_SPONSORS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DRIVE_SPONSORS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DRIVE_SPONSORS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DRIVE_SPONSORS_cur;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_SPONSORS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 OPEN CENTRAL_NOTES_cur; 
 FETCH CENTRAL_NOTES_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( CENTRAL_NOTES_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE CENTRAL_NOTES_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE CENTRAL_NOTES_cur;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_SPONSORS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DRIVES.DRIVE_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DRIVES.RELATION11'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DRIVE_SPONSORS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_SPONSORS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --

 rel_id := Find_Relation('DRIVES.RELATION12'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'CENTRAL_NOTES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

 string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

 if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then
 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 POST;
 Clear_Block(no_validate);
 -- Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);

 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

DECLARE

 l_count number := 0;
 v_count number := 0;
 l_note varchar2(500);
BEGIN
 update drive_sponsors set contact_id=:drives.s_sponsor_contact where 
 drive_id=:drives.drive_id;

 :system.message_level := '10' ;
 commit_form ;

/* Form should not be cleared after commit as user cannot see Drive ID */
-- execute_trigger( 'key-clrfrm' );
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.DRIVE_ID',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.DRIVE_ID',UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.DRIVE_ID',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_item('CONTROL_BLOCK.DRIVE_ID');

 ----- Check for null notes
 begin
 if :drives.note_id is not null then
 select count(*) into l_count
 from central_notes
 where note_id = :drives.note_id;
 if l_count = 0 then
 update drives set note_id = ''
 where drive_id = :control_block.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 commit;
 elsif l_count = 1 then
 select note into l_note
 from central_notes
 where note_id = :drives.note_id;
 if l_note is null then
 delete central_notes where note_id = :drives.note_id;
 update drives set note_id = '' 
 where drive_id = :control_block.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 commit;
 end if;
 else
 select count(*) into v_count
 from central_notes
 where note_id = :drives.note_id
 and note is not null;
 if v_count = 0 then
 delete central_notes where note_id = :drives.note_id;
 update drives set note_id = '' 
 where drive_id = :control_block.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 commit;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;

 show_error('9163') ;
 :system.message_level := '0' ;

END;
